name: io.github.yybd/telegram-notify-mcp
title: telegram-notify
description: Send-only Telegram notifications to one fixed chat. No polling, no recipient override, 2 tools.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bot token from @BotFather (or run `telegram-notify-mcp setup` to save it to a file instead)

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The one chat that receives every message; tools cannot change it

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_NOTIFY_FILES_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder notify_file may send from. Unset means file sending is off
